environment.description: Go Gin application deployed on a bare EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2, t3.medium) with direct internet-facing exposure via Elastic IP. No load balancer, no WAF, no reverse proxy. Security group allows inbound TCP/8080 from 0.0.0.0/0. Application compiled with CGO_ENABLED=1 and -O0 (no stack protector optimizations). ASLR disabled via sysctl kernel.randomize_va_space=0.
